headline: Judge Approves Bayer's $7.25 Billion Settlement Over Roundup Cancer Claims
summary: A Missouri state judge approved Bayer's $7.25 billion settlement to resolve lawsuits alleging its Roundup weedkiller causes cancer. The decision addresses approximately 65,000 claims that have burdened the German conglomerate for nearly a decade.
why: Bayer acquired Roundup maker Monsanto in 2018, inheriting extensive US product liability litigation that has constrained its balance sheet and stock performance.

impacts.name: Bayer
impacts.why: Court approval of the $7.25 billion settlement provides legal certainty after years of litigation over Roundup cancer claims.
